{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The FDA has slowly but relentlessly changed into an agency that more and more puts the public health at risk by delaying, chilling, and killing the development of new devices, drugs and biologics.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The FDA needs leadership that can reform the agency for this century and fix the lack of predictability, consistency, transparency and efficiency at the agency.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The FDA needs to return to its traditional emphasis on hard science and approving new breakthrough medicines, rather than divert its attention and consume its resources trying to overregulate electronic health records or vaping.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to restore the FDA to its position as the premier scientific health agency, focused on both promoting and protecting the public health in equal measure.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will remain the world leader in life sciences and medical innovation.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Millions of high-paying, cutting-edge device and drug jobs will stay in the United States.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"U.S. patients will benefit first and most from new devices and drugs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The FDA will no longer waste U.S. taxpayer and innovators' resources through bureaucratic red tape and legal uncertainty.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commendation of states that have passed Right to Try legislation, allowing terminally ill patients the right to try investigational medicines not yet approved by the FDA.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Urge Congress to pass federal legislation to give all Americans with terminal illnesses the right to try.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Under the last two Republican presidents, landmark civil rights legislation affirmed the inherent rights of persons with disabilities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to support the rights of persons with disabilities by guaranteeing access to education and the tools necessary to compete in the mainstream of society.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Tapping the pool of talented individuals with disabilities will benefit the country's future.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Republican leadership led to enactment of the ABLE Act, which for the first time lets people with disabilities maintain access to services while saving to develop assets.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Republican leadership led to enactment of the Steve Gleason Act, which provides access to speech-generating devices.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act will make it easier for students with disabilities to pursue competitive employment.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
